misconception_description: Student believes that variable identifiers can only be one letter long.

solutions.generated_code:
program MatriksIdentitas
kamus
  n, i, j : integer
  b : string
algoritma
  input(n)
  for i <- 1 to n do
    b <- ""
    for j <- 1 to n do
      if i == j then
        b <- b + "1 "
      else
        b <- b + "0 "
      endif
    endfor
    output(b)
  endfor
endprogram
